issues.title: Acquisition import dry run with a real first batch
issues.summary: The first real batch from the acquisition pipeline goes through the import on staging as a dry run, then a real import there, before any live import.
scope: The acquisition side hands over a batch in the contract format (docs/contracts/import-format.md); neither side reads the other folders
An Administrator runs the dry run in wp-admin (or CLI) and reviews the diff
Check refusals: hash mismatch, suppression hit, missing provenance, forbidden field, under-18 guard
Import on staging, check the review queue, undo the batch, import again (idempotent)
Report findings; plugin defects become issues for the import module (type:discovered)
A 1,000-record chunked run if the batch is large enough (see M5-OPS-03)
acceptance: A dry run shows a diff and writes nothing
Records that fail verification are refused with the reason logged
What is imported equals what was drafted, confirmed by recomputed content hash
Re-importing never overwrites a reviewed field
A suppressed person is not imported
Imported organisations are Published - review pending and individuals are not public, and all appear in the review queue
Undoing the batch removes it and restores the prior state
